95684309f6.q: How did Jay Baysden start Baycom Computer and Networks as a side hustle?
95684309f6.a: Jay joined the Navy in 1997 and got into the computer field. After getting out and working in IT at Fort Eustis, he needed extra spare money, so he took a real estate sign, stood it up in the back of his truck, and put 'computer repair' and his phone number on it. That's how Baycom started 19 years ago.

905522bde1.q: What is Jay Baysden's core business advice for entrepreneurs starting a new venture?
905522bde1.a: Jay emphasizes doing your homework and researching your field and market thoroughly before investing heavily. He advises speaking to industry experts—such as an IT professional or real estate agent—to understand the technical and financial sides before committing significant capital. He warns that many entrepreneurs fail because they don't do enough research and simply 'throw a dart and see what sticks,' potentially losing up to $400,000 on an ill-informed business.
